invariants.rationale: The method getMaxWidth() immediately uses 'maxWidth', so it needs to be non-null at method entry.
The call to maxWidth.get(actor) requires 'actor' to be non-null at method entry.
The method padLeft.get(this) later in the method requires 'padLeft' to be non-null at method entry.
The method padRight.get(this) later in the method requires 'padRight' to be non-null at method entry.
Within an instance method, 'this' is guaranteed not to be null.
